scenes.text: One sunny morning, Luna skipped into the emerald forest, her curious eyes sparkling with wonder at every rustling leaf.
Deep among the mossy roots, she found an ancient oak tree with a face carved by time itself, and it slowly opened its eyes.
"Hello, little one," the tree whispered warmly. "I have been waiting a hundred years for a friend as brave as you."
Luna smiled and sat beneath its branches, and together they watched fireflies dance as the tree told tales of long ago.
From that day on, Luna visited every morning, and the forest never felt quiet or lonely again.
